aboutGame.title: What is Undertale Adventures X?
paragraphs: Undertale Adventures X is a Roblox tower defense game from Side Productions that rebuilds the Underground and its cast as deployable units. You place characters along a lane, they attack incoming monster waves automatically, and you spend in-match currency to upgrade them before enemies reach your base.

Between runs you collect permanent resources, summon new units with Souls, evolve them into stronger forms, and reroll traits to raise their ceiling. Our wiki covers every system with codes, unit tier lists, evolution breakdowns, and step-by-step progression guides.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Undertale Adventures X.

items.question: What is Undertale Adventures X?
items.answer: Undertale Adventures X is a free-to-play Roblox tower defense game from Side Productions. You defend a base from monster waves using Undertale-inspired units, then upgrade them, evolve them, and roll traits to clear harder chapters.

items.question: What is the only working Undertale Adventures X code right now?
items.answer: MOREFREESTUFF is the single active Undertale Adventures X code. It grants 25x Trait Rerolls, 3 Gaster Hands, and 1,000x Souls. Codes can expire within hours of release, so redeem anything new the day you find it.

items.question: How do I redeem Undertale Adventures X codes?
items.answer: Stay in the main lobby, click the Codes button, type the code exactly as shown, and confirm. Press Enter on PC, A on Xbox, X on PlayStation, or tap outside the box on mobile to claim the rewards.

items.question: Which units are best in Undertale Adventures X?
items.answer: Community tier lists put Sans, Asriel, Mettaton NEO, Undyne the Undying, and Papyrus in the top band for their roles. Asgore, Muffet, and Mettaton EX are the named backups if you are missing an S-tier pick.

items.question: Is Undertale Adventures X free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Undertale Adventures X is a free Roblox experience, and any spending beyond that is optional, such as the gamepass that boosts Token yields from Raids mode.

items.question: How often does Undertale Adventures X update?
items.answer: Undertale Adventures X has no published schedule. Emergency hotfixes arrive quickly, while balance passes and content drops are developer-driven and often tied to events, milestones, or community feedback.
